issues_found.description: internal/loomcli/run.go still calls the deleted package-level attachArgv(socket, session string) free function instead of the new Engine.AttachArgv(cols, rows int) method. c.reed is a *reedengine.Engine, so this call site needed the same update applied to internal/reedcli/attach.go (read terminal size via term.GetSize and call c.reed.AttachArgv(cols, rows)). Since attachArgv no longer exists anywhere in the codebase, this is a compile error, not just a missed behavioral update.
issues_found.evidence: go build ./... and go vet ./internal/loomcli/... both fail with 'internal/loomcli/run.go:295:46: undefined: attachArgv'. Confirmed via git show HEAD that the free function attachArgv was deleted from internal/reedcli/attach.go in this same commit, and via grep -rn "func attachArgv" that no such function exists anywhere in the repo. Also confirmed c.reed's type is *reedengine.Engine at internal/loomcli/cli.go:44, matching the receiver type of the new AttachArgv method, and that reedengine/attach.go's own top-of-file comment explicitly names internal/loomcli as a second caller that builds its terminal handover from AttachArgv.
